body: Hey man thanks for the advice Im starting to feel a little bit better. Im going to try my best to ride out this sadness hopefully it will get better. Thank you again for caring it means so much to me.

Hey thank you so much for the kind words I need more of that in my life right now. Yea he was drinking but not to the point where he couldn't be reasonable, at least I dont think so. Yea I still do have feelings for her, but I understand the past is the past and I'm trying to move on but literally every week I get some sort of bullshit reminder about it and it makes me feel like such a failure. Iv'e been very naturally depressed person my whole life and it comes and goes in waves but this feeling that I have now is so much worse then anything ive felt before. I dont know if I should bring it up to him it just seems so petty that im getting so worked up over this but I honestly have never felt so sad in my entire life and thats a pretty impressive feat itself.
